profile.headline: IT Swiss Army Knife
profile.summary:
I've done a little bit of everything when it comes to software and IT, going from help desk support and onboarding for software, to diving into data warehouses with large records to put together elaborate custom reports, writing automated testing scripts, and am currently honing my skills as a software engineer.

On the side I work as a freelance camera operator for sporting and concert events.
